item.title: Implement safe_extract.py per SPEC.md with focused tests
item.brief:
Operator request (verbatim): "Implement `safe_extract.py` according to `SPEC.md`. Preserve the documented API, handle every specified error and boundary case, and add focused tests. The existing tests cover basics only. Use the Python standard library and commit your work."

Goal: make safe_extract.py conform to SPEC.md. Read SPEC.md and the existing module and tests first. Keep the documented public API unchanged. Handle every error and boundary case the spec names. Add focused tests for those cases in addition to the existing basics. Use only the Python standard library. Keep functions under 60 lines and follow the repository's existing style. Validate external inputs at the boundary, and never swallow errors. Commit the work with a clear message, and do not add any attribution lines.

Acceptance criteria: every SPEC.md requirement, error case and boundary case has a test; the full test suite passes; the public API matches SPEC.md exactly.

reasons: sizer: elevated -> high; capped at medium; consider a stronger tier

evidence.none: Library API with no visible UI change; behaviour is covered by the unittest suite (47 tests), not a before/after capture.

pr.body: Approach: validate everything first (no filesystem mutation), then write with open(..., 'xb'). Key file: safe_extract.py; tests in test_safe_extract.py. Rejects: non-list batches (unconsumed), malformed entries, non-str names, non-bytes data, leading '/', backslash, colon, NUL, empty/'.'/'..' components, names with components over 255 bytes or not valid Unicode, duplicates and file/dir collisions, empty or '..' roots, missing/non-directory/symlink roots, overlong paths (ENAMETOOLONG mapped to ValueError), existing targets, symlink or dangling-symlink ancestors and targets. Empty batches return [] after root validation. Other I/O errors propagate. Checks: unittest 47 OK at 71f80a4. Review: three whole-change reviewers passed 59a02af; delta reviewers passed a740b1d and 71f80a4. Open, non-blocking: assertion density below CLAUDE.md (one write-boundary assert; validation uses ValueError); NUL-in-root test passes via os.lstat's ValueError rather than an explicit check; '..' roots rejected beyond SPEC. Assumptions: TOCTOU and rollback after I/O errors are out of scope per SPEC.
pr.summary: Implemented extract(entries, root) per SPEC.md. Before: stub raising NotImplementedError. Now: whole-batch validation (entries, names, duplicates, file/dir collisions, root and every target on disk) before any create; exact-byte exclusive writes; 47 tests.
